hide_engaged_mobs.label: Hide engaged mobs
hide_engaged_mobs.tooltip: Stop drawing a trigger range after a mob has acquired a target.

fill_circles.label: Fill range circles
fill_circles.tooltip: Fill the inside of each range circle with a low-opacity color.

auto_calibrate.label: Auto-calibrate passive pulls
auto_calibrate.tooltip: Record the trigger distance when a mob first acquires the local player; active attacks and FATE mobs are rejected.

auto_avoidance.label: Automatically avoid aggro circles
auto_avoidance.tooltip: Precompute North Horn detours so automatic navigation avoids unengaged ordinary-mob trigger ranges.

avoidance_safety_margin.label: Route safety margin
avoidance_safety_margin.tooltip: Extra clearance retained outside the trigger radius. The recommended value is 2 yalms.

dynamic_replanning.label: Replan around moving mobs
dynamic_replanning.tooltip: Build a replacement route in the background when a mob moves into the remaining path; movement continues until it is ready.

replan_cooldown_seconds.label: Replan cooldown (seconds)
replan_cooldown_seconds.tooltip: Limit how often moving mobs can trigger a replacement route.

draw_avoidance_path.label: Draw avoidance waypoints
draw_avoidance_path.tooltip: Draw the corrected vnavmesh waypoints as small cyan circles for testing.

max_draw_distance.label: Maximum draw distance
max_draw_distance.tooltip: Only draw ordinary mobs within this distance of the player.

near_boundary_distance.label: Boundary warning distance
near_boundary_distance.tooltip: Turn a circle orange when the player is this close to its boundary.

radius_adjustment.label: Radius adjustment
radius_adjustment.tooltip: Apply one correction to all trigger radii.

vertical_tolerance.label: Maximum height difference
vertical_tolerance.tooltip: Ignore mobs beyond this vertical difference to avoid cross-floor warnings.

fill_opacity.label: Fill opacity
fill_opacity.tooltip: Opacity used for the inside of range circles.

outside_color.label: Outside color
outside_color.tooltip: Circle color while safely outside its boundary.

near_color.label: Near-boundary color
near_color.tooltip: Circle color while approaching its boundary.

inside_color.label: Inside color
inside_color.tooltip: Circle color after entering the estimated trigger range.
